caseNameFull: Wainwright, Secretary, Department of Offender Rehabilitation of Florida v. Sykes

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 883.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and 15 minutes allotted for that purpose. Counsel for respondent also allotted an additional 15 minutes for oral argument.
